description: This bar chart illustrates the number of datasets categorized as “Targets” and “Untargeted” across the years 2012 to 2022. The horizontal axis represents “Year,” with labels ranging from 2012 to 2022 in sequential order, and is a categorical axis. The vertical axis is labeled “Number of datasets” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 160, with tick marks at 20-unit intervals. For each year, there are two bars presented side-by-side: a blue bar representing “Targets” and an orange bar representing “Untargeted” datasets, as indicated by the legend. In 2012, both the “Targets” and “Untargeted” bars are minimal, with the “Targets” bar reaching approximately 1 and the “Untargeted” bar reaching approximately 2. The bars generally increase in height from 2012 to 2022, with the “Untargeted” bar consistently taller than the “Targets” bar for each year. In 2022, the “Targets” bar reaches a value of approximately 110, while the “Untargeted” bar reaches a value of approximately 155. The bars are arranged chronologically by year and no bars are visually emphasized.
